how: Part 3 in main's variant (checks/agy002_m34_part3.py: the same 1,325 words and weights, with main's 24-point average on B1932's grid in place of the marked point's own read-out, against B1940's corrected area values). The three stable weights agree with the note to about 0.02: length-weighted 0.521 and 0.507 (the note 0.525, 0.515), uniform 0.500 and 0.492 (0.509, 0.501), the one-loop weight 0.441 and 0.442 (0.460, 0.459). The eta weights make the gap larger and give negative values among the fourteen; their figures differ from the note's, as an unstable ratio's would
note: The conclusion holds on main: no weight tried closes the gap of about 0.52 between the move count and the area. Main's own two measures in B1940's file differ by 0.516 and 0.503.
